answer_text: To regain CMA admin access when MFA is tied to a device, reset MFA for the affected administrator. In CMA, go to Account > Administrators, select the admin, and choose Reset MFA. The next login will prompt the admin to scan a new QR code with an authenticator app to re-link MFA. Note: if you’re using SSO for CMA logins, MFA cannot be enforced in CMA logins; use the SSO path instead.
